title: Function Block Advanced PIDE (Cascade)
description: Schema for a pair of cascaded PIDE controllers (primary & secondary). The secondary (slave) PIDE is configured for Cascade mode and receives SPCascade from the primary’s CV:contentReference[oaicite:164]{index=164}.

SPProg.description: Program setpoint (used if in program control and not cascaded).

SPOper.description: Operator setpoint (used if in operator control and not cascaded).

SPCascade.description: Cascade Setpoint (EU):contentReference[oaicite:165]{index=165}. This is the remote SP received from a primary loop. When Cascade mode is active (CasRat mode), the PIDE uses SPCascade (or SPCascade * Ratio) as its target:contentReference[oaicite:166]{index=166}:contentReference[oaicite:167]{index=167}. For the secondary controller, this should be wired to the primary’s CVEU output.

UseRatio.description: Use Ratio control:contentReference[oaicite:168]{index=168}. True if performing ratio control (SP = SPCascade * Ratio). In a pure cascade (no ratio scaling), this remains false:contentReference[oaicite:169]{index=169}.

RatioProg.description: Program ratio multiplier:contentReference[oaicite:170]{index=170}. Used if UseRatio=true and in Program control. Multiplies the SPCascade for ratio control. Default 1.0.

RatioOper.description: Operator ratio multiplier:contentReference[oaicite:171]{index=171}. Used if UseRatio=true in Operator control. Default 1.0.

RatioHLimit.description: Ratio high limit:contentReference[oaicite:172]{index=172}. Max allowed Ratio value. Default 1.0. If RatioProg/Oper exceed this, Ratio is clamped and flagged.

RatioLLimit.description: Ratio low limit:contentReference[oaicite:173]{index=173}. Min allowed Ratio (min 0.0). Default 1.0 (meaning ratio cannot drop below 1.0 unless changed). If set <0, it will be forced to 0 at runtime:contentReference[oaicite:174]{index=174}.

CVInitReq.description: CV Initialize Request:contentReference[oaicite:175]{index=175}. Should be wired to the 'In Hold' status of the final output or, in cascade, to the primary loop’s InitPrimary output:contentReference[oaicite:176]{index=176}. When true, this secondary loop’s CV will reset to CVInitValue to avoid bumps on startup or mode change.

CVInitValue.description: CV Initialization Value (EU):contentReference[oaicite:177]{index=177}. The output value to use when CVInitReq is true. In cascade, the primary’s CVInitValue should be wired from the secondary’s SP to ensure bumpless transfer when secondary exits cascade:contentReference[oaicite:178]{index=178}.

CVPrevious.description: Previous CV (for bumpless gain changes):contentReference[oaicite:179]{index=179}. Normally managed internally. Can be set if CVSetPrevious=true to preset last CV value.

CVSetPrevious.description: Use CVPrevious flag:contentReference[oaicite:180]{index=180}. True = use the provided CVPrevious as last CV for the next scan (to manually initialize CV history, e.g., when integrating loops).

CVManLimiting.description: Manual Limiting Enable:contentReference[oaicite:181]{index=181}. If true, CV is also limited by CVHLimit/CVLLimit even in Manual modes. Default false (limits apply only in Auto/Cascade).

CVHLimit.description: CV high limit (%). Might be set lower than 100 in cascade to prevent primary driving secondary beyond its capability (also secondary will have its own limit).

WindupHIn.description: Windup High Prevent Input:contentReference[oaicite:182]{index=182}. True = instruct primary loop to stop integrating upwards. In cascade, wire this from the secondary’s WindupHOut output to the primary’s WindupHIn:contentReference[oaicite:183]{index=183}. This helps prevent primary windup if secondary saturates high.

WindupLIn.description: Windup Low Prevent Input:contentReference[oaicite:184]{index=184}. True = stop primary from integrating downward. Wire from secondary’s WindupLOut to primary’s WindupLIn:contentReference[oaicite:185]{index=185}.

PVTracking.description: PV tracking (SP track PV in Manual).

AllowCasRat.description: Allow Cascade/Ratio mode:contentReference[oaicite:186]{index=186}. **For the secondary (slave)**, set true to allow it to enter Cascade mode (controlled by CasRatReq bits):contentReference[oaicite:187]{index=187}. The primary can keep this false (it doesn't need to go into cascade mode, it operates in Auto).

ProgCasRatReq.description: Program request Cascade mode:contentReference[oaicite:188]{index=188}. For secondary, set true (via user logic) to put it into Cascade mode (provided AllowCasRat=true):contentReference[oaicite:189]{index=189}. For primary, this remains false (primary stays in normal Auto).

OperCasRatReq.description: Operator request Cascade mode. Similar to ProgCasRatReq but from an HMI. For secondary loop, an operator could use this to initiate cascade mode (with AllowCasRat true):contentReference[oaicite:190]{index=190}.
